svg.text: CVA6 MRET Instruction Execution & Pipeline Restore Waveform (Cycles 450 – 462)
Execution of MRET at 0x8000_0110 (Cyc 454) asserts Eret=1, flushes the entire pipeline, and restores FetchPC from mepc (0x8000_0074) to resume main code at Cyc 461.

• Cyc 451–452: Handler increments return PC (addi t4, t4, 4) and writes mepc=0x8000_0074 via csrw mepc, t4. • Cyc 454: MRET commits at 0x8000_0110. Eret=1 triggers controller.sv to flush all pipeline stages (BP/IF/ID/EX) and vector FetchPC to CsrEpc=0x8000_0074. Main code commits at Cyc 461.
